tools.name: edinet_financials_usgaap
tools.description: Search official EDINET statutory balance sheet, income statement, and executive compensation for Japanese listed companies, strictly mapped to US GAAP / IFRS. Covers 5-year XBRL financials with J-GAAP / US GAAP / IFRS accounting concept mapping (e.g. 経常利益 vs Operating Income vs Ordinary Income).

tools.name: japan_corporate_registry
tools.description: Query official 13-digit National Tax Agency (NTA) corporate identity, registered headquarters address, legal status, and METI gBizINFO certifications, subsidies, and commendations for any Japanese company.

tools.name: japan_company_search
tools.description: Unified keyword, fuzzy, and semantic search across Japanese corporate registries and listed company filings. Supports search by company name (Japanese or English), securities code, corporate number, or any free-text query.
